entities.name: Query enzyme (329 aa)
observations: 329 aa soluble enzyme; predicted molecular mass 35.77 kDa and theoretical pI 8.57.
Pfam matches: ADH_N_2 at residues 5–104; ADH_zinc_N at 154–278; ADH_zinc_N_2 at 186–327.
Full-length homology to reviewed prostaglandin reductase 1 proteins: 63.1% identity and 100% coverage to Bos taurus Q3SZJ4; E-value 7.22e-149.
Functional annotation is supported by strong homology but exact substrate specificity remains inferential for the query sequence.

entities.name: Prostaglandin reductase 1
observations: Reviewed homologs annotate an NAD(P)H-dependent oxidoreductase involved in inactivation of prostaglandins, leukotrienes, lipoxins, alkenals, and ketones.

Primary activity is reduction of the 13,14 double bond in 15-oxo-prostaglandins; additional activities include 13,14 reduction of 15-oxo-lipoxin A4 and reduction of alpha,beta-unsaturated alkenals and ketones.
Homolog annotations include EC 1.3.1.48 and EC 1.3.1.74; localization is cytoplasmic and the protein may be monomeric or homodimeric.

entities.name: 15-oxo-prostaglandin 13-reduction
observations: Representative reaction: 13,14-dihydro-15-oxo-prostaglandin E1 + NADP(+) = 15-oxoprostaglandin E1 + NADPH + H(+), corresponding to the reverse direction of NADPH-dependent reduction of the 13,14 double bond.
Related substrates in homolog annotations include 15-oxo-PGE2, 15-oxo-PGF1alpha, and 15-oxo-PGF2alpha.

entities.name: 2-alkenal reduction
observations: Representative reaction: an alpha,beta-unsaturated alkenal + NADPH + H(+) -> saturated alkanal + NADP(+), shown in the retrieved Rhea mapping in reverse notation.
Homologs report activity toward medium-chain alkenals and ketones, including (2E)-decenal, (3E)-3-nonen-2-one, and 4-hydroxy-2-nonenal.

entities.name: Leukotriene B4 oxidation
observations: Homologs can oxidize the C12 hydroxyl of leukotriene B4 to form 12-oxo-leukotriene B4 using NADP(+) as electron acceptor, although this is a lower-efficiency secondary activity.
